name: SOC-009: Data Exfiltration Detected
description: Detects data exfiltration attempts including large file transfers and upload to external services.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%LinuxServer%' AND (payload ILIKE '%rsync%' OR payload ILIKE '%scp%' OR (payload ILIKE '%curl%' AND payload ILIKE '%http%') OR payload ILIKE '%--remove-source-files%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
